_note: Push notifications (todo-pwa.md). Read by the site (reports/assets/app.js, via reports/data/push.json) and by scripts/notify.py. Public values only: the private VAPID key and the admin token are repo/Worker secrets, never committed.
_group_note: Super-league id (Chris, 2026-10-30: keep the door open to more super leagues in one app). Every follow stored in the push store is prefixed '<group>|' (e.g. 'ncaa180|Big Sky:6'); this pipeline only reads its own group's follows.
_worker_url_note: Set after the Cloudflare Worker is deployed, e.g. https://ncaa180-push.<account>.workers.dev (no trailing slash). Empty = push UI shows 'coming soon' and the sender skips push.

events.label: National champion and Stagg Bowl winner

_events_note: Only events the sender produces today are listed. Polls and weekly awards get added here when they are wired (todo-pwa.md MVP).
_prestige_note: Order of games inside a push after the device's own followed teams (Chris, 2026-10-30): playoff, bowl, NIT. CCG only appears in CCG week, so its place is moot.
_champions_note: National champion + Stagg Bowl winner go to every device that follows at least one team, whatever its event toggles (Chris, 2026-10-30).
_discord_events_note: Events that ALSO post to the league Discord channel through announce(). Empty until Chris turns one on: push launched without changing what Discord gets today.
